name: Morag
source:
Morag is the self-proclaimed brains of the operation - she takes care of 'human' resources, and the horrifying monster known as... paperwork.

Morally opposed to the whole drowning humans thing Kelpies are famous for (also, it's a logistical nightmare).

[From [url=https://sad-ghost-studios.itch.io/werehouse]itch.io[/url]]
